mermaid:
flowchart LR
    PIM["Product system of record"] -->|"content and GTINs"| CON["Channel connector"]
    AV["Availability service"] -->|"stock per channel"| CON
    PR["Pricing source"] -->|"channel prices"| CON
    CON -->|"listings, stock, prices"| MP["bol, Amazon.de, Zalando"]
    MP -->|"orders, cancellations, returns"| CON
    CON -->|"marketplace orders"| OMS["Order record"]
    OMS -->|"fulfillment orders"| WMS["Warehouse"]
    WMS -->|"shipment and tracking"| OMS
    OMS -->|"ship confirmation"| CON
    CON -->|"tracking to marketplace"| MP

sequenceDiagram
    participant MP as Amazon.de
    participant CON as Connector
    participant OMS as Order record
    participant WMS as Warehouse
    participant SH as Shipping service
    MP->>CON: New order notification or poll result
    CON->>OMS: Create order with marketplace order id and ship-by date
    OMS-->>CON: Internal order number
    CON->>MP: Acknowledge, bind internal number to marketplace id
    OMS->>WMS: Fulfillment order
    WMS->>SH: Label and carrier booking
    SH-->>WMS: Tracking number
    WMS-->>OMS: Shipped with tracking
    OMS->>CON: Ship confirmation
    CON->>MP: Confirm shipment with carrier and tracking
    MP-->>CON: Buyer cancellation or return announced, later
    CON->>OMS: Cancellation or return event
